concept.concept: Wrap-around design of a foggy graveyard at twilight with the handle positioned as a lit lantern post and 'Mornings Are Scary Enough' printed on the front.
concept.audience: Halloween lovers and horror aesthetic fans who drink coffee daily
concept.rationale: The mug is the ideal product for this concept—handle as lantern is a clever product-integrated idea. Mornings plus horror is a beloved mug humor format. Strong gift potential for Halloween season perfectly timed at 6-8 weeks out.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Mornings Are Scary Enough" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a foggy graveyard at twilight. Centered composition: silhouetted tombstones and bare gnarled trees in the middle ground, thick fog banks rendered as solid horizontal bands obscuring the lower third. A tall wrought-iron lantern post with a glowing rectangular window positioned on the right side of center, warm golden light radiating from within. Single crescent moon pale yellow in the upper portion. Color palette: deep charcoal black, dark purple, fog gray, warm golden yellow, pale cream. Solid color blocks only, no gradients, no photorealism, no shadowing or airbrush effects. High contrast screen-print aesthetic. Design centered with generous margin on all sides, away from edges, on a solid black background that will be deleted in post-processing.
design.style: Bold retro serif typeface, white, arched across the upper third of the composition above the graveyard illustration. Clean, crisp letterforms with high readability at distance.

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Mornings Are Scary Enough' is a generic humorous expression combining a common sentiment about mornings with a casual horror reference. It does not appear to be a registered trademark, slogan associated with a specific brand, or tied to any copyrighted character, celebrity, team, or media property. The graveyard and lantern visual concept is generic Gothic/Halloween imagery with no specific IP associations. The overall design concept is original and commercially safe for print-on-demand.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly 'MORNINGS ARE SCARY ENOUGH' correctly spelled and complete. The artwork features a generic spooky graveyard scene with a lamp post, crescent moon, and bare trees — all common Halloween motifs with no IP concerns. Text is clean and legible, composition is suitable for garment printing with a solid black background.

listing.title: Mornings Are Scary Enough Halloween Coffee Mug with Graveyard Design
listing.description: Start every morning with a touch of the macabre. This wraparound mug features a foggy graveyard at twilight with the handle positioned as a glowing lantern post. 'Mornings Are Scary Enough' printed on the front speaks to coffee lovers who appreciate dark humor. Perfect for: horror enthusiasts, Halloween lovers who stay in character year-round, anyone who needs caffeine to face the day, Halloween aesthetic collectors. Great gift for coworkers with a dark sense of humor.
